description: WRITE-LV, what the earlier 3186 depends on (the first card's positioned recordset never read the memo). Process a opens a dynaset over table M, moves to row 4 and READS its memo Value (the earlier record had the dynaset sitting on the long-memo row 4); b replaces the memo of row 4 twice, then rows 3 and 1 (3,500+ characters, dbFailOnError, Errors before/after); a reads the memo again, moves to row 1 and reads, closes; b replaces row 4 once more and reads the lengths after a pause and Idle. Asks whether a recordset that has read a long value blocks its replacement (3186) while a merely positioned one does not.
